adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound. This allows a client to request an extremely large `?limit=` and force the server to load and serialize a very large member set (`serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer)`), creating a clear performance/DoS risk. The change also applies this pattern to all groups (not just automatic ones).
